visualReview.observation: The strong physical-phone blur was not reproduced in headless Chrome. Tab edges changed slightly; the approved sharpness metric increased.
The strong physical-phone blur was not reproduced on the about-to-home route. Tabs remain legible and the approved metric increased slightly.
The baseline tab and body text were visibly blurred. Final tab, heading, and body edges are clearly defined after releasing both persistent hints.
The baseline instant-return view was already relatively sharp. Final tabs and body remain clear; the approved metric increased slightly.
The baseline rezoom reproduced the initial desktop blur. The final rezoom has clear tabs, heading, and body text. The home-button reload still returns to the desk.

limitations: Headless Chrome does not establish physical-phone rendering or perceived animation smoothness. These are human QA items.
The enlarged background bitmap remains softer than the live text; the background image was not changed.
